snippet.title: Midnight Bowling 3 - Mobile Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The acclaimed, multi-million-selling series returns! 

Prepare for an even more realistic game and take on new and fun challenges to prove you're the best bowler around. Enjoy the famous Midnight atmosphere in cool and trendy locations from the Night Club to the Catwalk, and confront sexy bosses with their own special rules. Show them who's the real baller with customized bowling balls and power-ups that help you make amazing shots. Behold the new King of Bowling on mobile!
